rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; TractoInferno pretraining dataset from 6 studies on 3T scanners; ADNI from 7 acquisition protocols across 3 scanner vendors (Siemens, Philips, GE); NIMHANS from 2 scanners (Philips 3T Ingenia and Siemens 3T Skyra)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset, acquired on 3T scanners with b-values around 1000 s/mm² from six studies" and "collected using seven acquisition protocols - S31, S55, S127, P33, P36, GE36, and GE54... consisting of three scanner vendors"
rci1_using_msad.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.2.3 TractoInferno, L128; Methods / 2.2.1 ADNI, L85

rci2_using_epd.detail: ADNI CN subjects used as reference cohort for fine-tuning the normative VAE model; TractoInferno (198 HC from 6 studies) used for pretraining but is not in the EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing... The pretrained VAE model was fine-tuned on 30 bundles from the subjects in the training set, in each cohort"
rci2_using_epd.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.3.2 Data preparation and training, L168

rci3_epd_name.detail: ADNI CN subjects (447 total; training split 35% ≈ 156) used for fine-tuning normative model; NIMHANS is in-house data; TractoInferno is publicly available but not in EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI)... 447 cognitively normal (CN) participants"

rci5_n.detail: model-1: TractoInferno dataset, N=198 explicitly stated, all healthy adults; model-2: ADNI CN training split (35% of 447 CN = 156.45, rounded to 156), estimated from reported percentage and total CN N; model-3: NIMHANS CN training split (35% of 123 CN = 43.05, rounded to 43), estimated from reported percentage and total CN N; fine-tuning done separately per cohort (not pooled)
rci5_n.supporting_text: "this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes... from six studies" and "447 cognitively normal (CN) participants" and "123 CN participants" and "data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing"
rci5_n.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.2.3 TractoInferno, L128; Methods / 2.1 Participant demographics, L77; Methods / 2.3.2 Data preparation and training, L168

rci6_sex.detail: model-1: TractoInferno demographics (including sex) referred to external source Poulin et al. 2022 (Scientific Data); model-2 and model-3: Table 1 in the paper reports Male (%) for entire protocol samples (CN + MCI + dementia combined), not for CN-only training splits; CN-specific sex breakdown for ADNI and NIMHANS training splits is not separately reported
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "All participants in the TractoInferno are healthy adults. Demographics including age and sex are available elsewhere." [Poulin et al. 2022]; Table 1 reports Male (%) for total N per protocol (CN + MCI + dementia combined)

rci7_age.detail: model-1: TractoInferno demographics (including age) referred to external source Poulin et al. 2022 (Scientific Data); model-2 and model-3: Table 1 reports Age (Mean ± SD) for total N per protocol (CN + MCI + dementia combined); ADNI Total = 74.13 ± 7.93, NIMHANS Total = 67.25 ± 7.86, but these are not CN-specific training split values; CN-only age statistics for the training splits are not separately reported
rci7_age.supporting_text: "All participants in the TractoInferno are healthy adults. Demographics including age and sex are available elsewhere." [Poulin et al. 2022]; Table 1 Age(Mean ± SD) for ADNI Total: 74.13 ± 7.93, NIMHANS Total: 67.25 ± 7.86
